notes.title: Demo release, new translation and Autumn sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772148/208027b5378027921cee4b61f0d86571630c25a2.png[/img]


I just released the demo, a few months later than planned. 
Sorry for that. 

Both, the demo and the main game got a BR/PT and a fix for the RU translation. 

Isa will take part in the Autumn sale, starting tomorrow, so if you are interested grab it the next days ;) 


Cheers,

BTT
